description.en:
UBTECH's Panda Robot, named Youyou, is a customized humanoid created for the China Pavilion at Expo 2020 Dubai. It uses technology from the Walker platform within a panda-inspired exterior, combining a recognizable character with visitor interaction and cultural demonstrations.

The manufacturer describes 41 servo-driven joints, an expressive curved-screen eye system, a removable battery and coordinated whole-body movement. Its demonstrated roles include greeting visitors, calligraphy and painting. Navigation, balance and hand-eye coordination support the physical presentation. Youyou is a specific exhibition-oriented robot, so its role and configuration should be distinguished from UBTECH's general commercial or industrial Walker models.
